title: fix(plugin-kanban): draw the no-value swimlane from kanban.uncategorized
body:
Fixes #12899
Clause-②: no

## What

The swimlane that holds cards with no value in the swimlane field was headed by the English constant `UNCATEGORIZED_LANE`, and the same word was interpolated into the lane cell's accessible name (`kanban.laneCards`). Under zh the heading read "Uncategorized" and the cell "待规划 - Uncategorized 的卡片". Both now draw `t('kanban.uncategorized')` through the board's own `useKanbanT` (English default added to the hook). The key exists in all ten packs, so no language-pack edit.

Display only. Classification of every use of `UNCATEGORIZED_LANE`: bucket key (unchanged) in the `swimlanes` memo, the lane's card count filter and the cell's card filter; the lane element key, `toggleLane` and `collapsedLanes` use the `lane` bucket key as well. Display: the lane heading and the `lane` interpolated into `kanban.laneCards`, both now through `laneLabel`.

## Acceptance notes

- A stored value literally "Uncategorized" still shares the no-value bucket (and so is headed by the translated word under zh). Noted, not fixed, as ruled.

Reason: the shared verify lock was held for over 45 minutes by a whole-package `packages/app-shell/` run (pid 7922) and the queue timed out (exit 99) three times; the place is kept as slot `issue-12899`.
